Author: KEWI
Name: Keybound Brawler Helper
Punchline: Auto-play and MGC tracker for the Keybound Brawler Gold Saucer event.
Description:
Reads the enemy words in Keybound Brawler and types them for you at a human pace, opens the input box, pauses on no-typing casts and remembers obscured boss words. Also tracks MGC and plans event rewards. /kbb opens the window, /kbb auto toggles auto-play.

Auto-play is against the FFXIV Terms of Service. Use at your own risk.
